newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hwan Yung faces deadline to repay debts.
newsitem.headline: Hwan Yung faces deadline to repay debts.

text.p: Hwan Yung Steel Industry Co Ltd failed to repay 590 million won of debts on Monday and is faced with a final deadline by the end of Tuesday to repay debts, officials at one of the company's creditor banks said on Tuesday.
"Hwan Yung did not settle promissory notes that matured yesterday and it has to pay back the debt by the end of today," said an official at Chung Chong Bank.
The official, who declined to be named, added that about one billion won worth of promissory notes would also become due for repayment by the close of business on Tuesday.
Hwan Yung officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
